jobs.description:
Desay SV Automotive Europe GmbH, the European headquarters of Desay SV Automotive, is located in Weimar, Germany. As a technology specialist for advanced hardware, software, and connectivity, we play a key role in transferring Desay SV’s global innovation strength into tailored solutions for the European automotive market. Our corporate culture is characterized by dynamism, diversity, openness and fairness.

Desay SV Europe is part of Huizhou Desay SV Automotive Co., Ltd. based in China, a leading, stock exchange-listed provider of mobility solutions in the fields of Smart Cabin, Smart Drive and Smart Service. As a top 100 supplier and with its high level of technology expertise, Desay SV supports car manufacturers worldwide in their mobility transformation, making driving safer, more comfortable and more efficient.

We are looking for Key Account Manager OEM (m/f/d) in France

Your tasks

- Support and development of named OEM customers (European car manufacturers)
- Responsibility for the acquisition process up to the receipt of orders and sales for the assigned clientele
- Identification and target-oriented responsibility for closing new projects using standardised "Request for Information" (RFI) as well as "Request for Quotation" (RFQ)
- Development of measures to achieve agreed targets (customers and products)
- Preparation and presentation of contracts ready for conclusion to superiors
- Active market observation, support of benchmark activities and trade fair participation
- Participation in corporate planning
- Induction of new employees
- Application of QM regulations
- Support in other operationally necessary activities, also outside the usual sales tasks and activities

Your profile

- At least completed technical training (industry-related)
- Industry knowledge and work experience appropriate for the position
- Organisational talent
- Excellent negotiating skills
- Confident appearance
- Communication skills
- Entrepreneurial thinking
- Assertiveness
- Strong sense of responsibility
- Ability to work in a team
- Knowledge of foreign languages (written and spoken English and German)
- High degree of decisiveness
- Confident handling of MS-Office
- High mobility
- At least driving licence class B

We offer

- Training and continuing education
- Individual training
- Company cell phone
- Company laptop
- 30 Vacation days per year
- Company car
- Parking lot
- Flexible working hours
- Mobile working
- Good traffic connections
- Employee bonuses
- Employee events
- Friendly and trustful colleagues
- Accident insurance (private and professional)

We look forward to receiving your application.

Core mission:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.

Under the responsibility of the Head of the Site Security and Protection Service (SSP), which is part of the ILL's Reactor Division, you will help to ensure the safety and security of persons and property on the site. You will assist in the surveillance of the various secured areas on the ILL site and will work in collaboration with the shift teams in the reactor control room.

Your tasks:
? Perform CCTV site surveillance and alarm handling.
? Perform surveillance on the installations.
? Initiate and guide specialist emergency or intervention teams.
? Issue site access and carry out entry and exit controls at different locations.
? Conduct security patrols.
? Act as a first responder in the event of a fire and liaise with external emergency services.
? Take action upon request by the emergency services or provide assistance to victims.
? Perform various alarm verifications.
? Process and relay site-security-related information and fill in the service logbook.
? Take part in the periodic tests and inspections for which the Site Security and Protection Service is responsible.
? Facilitate access as appropriate to the different zones for visitors, researchers and scientists within the responsibility of the SSP.

Your profile:
? You have a Level 3/4 qualification ('A' level equivalent) in the field of security.
? You hold a valid private security guard licence (CNAPS licence, SIA licence or equivalent).
? You have solid professional experience in the emergency services (for example, the military, police or fire service), or in the private or public security sector.
? You are dynamic and meticulous, follow rules and respect your manager. You thrive on teamwork and demonstrate a high degree of adaptability.
? You have no difficulty using computer technology or monitoring technology (screens) required for the job.
? You are able to handle stress and remain in control of yourself at all times.
? You are able to apply the appropriate procedures and instructions, but can also show initiative and discerning judgment.
? An intermediate level of English is desirable. Sound knowledge of French is required.

What we offer
Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a secure permanent position based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

Sounds interesting?
Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online via our career portal by 01/11/2026, quoting reference number 26/45. Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness (including for work under ionising radiation) is required. You will also have to perform an emergency response role in the event of a crisis. We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

At Miele, we work every day on products and services that stand for uncompromising quality. We do this with people who take responsibility, collaborate across borders, and strive for continuous improvement. For our Western Europe cluster, we are looking for an experienced Accounting Manager with excellent people management skills.
Alongside your existing skills and experience, we're looking for engaged team players who will collaborate, innovate and use their passion to drive an exceptional customer experience at every touchpoint.
If you are the best at what you do and have bold ideas and ambitions for progressing your career with Miele we want to hear from you!

What you will be doing:
As Accounting Manager, you are responsible for the strategic and operational oversight of financial reporting and projects across the four markets of the cluster: Belgium, Luxemburg, France and the Netherlands. You ensure the quality, reliability and compliance of financial information, while developing a forward-looking perspective for the cluster. You oversee a team of accounting experts and work closely with local teams, regional finance, the international shared service center in Poland, and the global Miele organization

Key responsibilities:
Lead and develop a team of five (3 accounting officers and 2 credit controllers).
Strengthen capabilities, drive performance, and foster collaboration within the team, with the International Shared Service Center and across departments.
Lead the month-end and year-end closing financial processes .
Ensure timely, accurate and compliant reporting of financial data (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow) in accordance with Miele guidelines and local legislation.
Act as the local point of contact for tax, legal and credit management related activities within the cluster.
Ensure transfer pricing and intercompany compliance in line with Group policies.
Act as Compliance Ambassador, safeguarding accounting integrity and financial governance.
Contribute to project design, coordinate central and local stakeholders, and drive harmonization of financial processes across the cluster.
Deliver pragmatic, value-driven solutions to operational needs.

Why you should choose this job at Miele:
At Miele, we are committed to talent, growth and sustainability. We are building a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone gets equal opportunities and can be the best version of themselves. Working from your talent makes you happy and gives you energy and desire to make a difference. Together, we develop innovative solutions that help the company succeed and make life easier for many households.

We offer you:
A permanent contract.
A competitive salary based on your experience and skills.
Flexible working hours, combined with remote working (2 days/week), to help you strike a good balance between work and leisure time.
Work location: HQ Le Blanc Mesnil, and the tools you need to work to the best of your ability.
A strong brand and a stable family business that attaches great importance to customer satisfaction.

The Accounting Manager we are looking for:
Proven knowledge of accounting, tax and legal matters in an international context.
Education in finance and accounting, preferably CFA, CPA, FA or equivalent.
5+ years of leadership experience and excellent people management skills.
Strong business acumen and a commercial mindset.
Ability to communicate complex financial information clearly and effectively.
Experience working in a multinational, multi-location and multilingual environment.
Comfortable operating within a matrix organization with diverse stakeholders.
Excellent command of English and French (both written and spoken at C1-level).
Professional, meticulous and collaborative communication style.

Would you like to join us on a quest for "Immer Besser" and further develop your career? Then apply now!

The ILL is an international research facility at the forefront of neutron science and technology. Its High-Flux Nuclear Reactor delivers the world's most intense neutron beams to a suite of over 40 scientific instruments. Every year, some 1800 international researchers visit the ILL to carry out cutting-edge experiments across a range of scientific disciplines, driving innovation in the fields of health, energy, the environment and quantum materials. The ILL is also involved in the production of radioisotopes for medical applications. The ILL employs over 500 staff from 25 different countries, in a diversity of careers and a multicultural and inclusive environment.

The Reactor Division is responsible for the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of ILL's high flux reactor. It oversees reactor operations, fuel management, maintenance, engineering, radiation protection, and technical support. The RDe employs around 100 people, mostly reactor operators and maintenance technicians and nuclear engineers, as well as safety, radiation protection and operations support staff.

We are looking for two mechanical maintenance technicians, who will join the group in charge of radioisotope production and maintenance of the equipment's in the Reactor Division. This group works on all of the reactor's handling facilities, as well as the irradiation processes for medical research.

Your tasks
-    Perform fuel-related handling operations: loading and unloading, replacement of water inside the fuel handling columns. 
-    Maintain the equipment that makes up the reactor's handling facilities: fuel handing columns, handling cranes and gantries, reactor pool gates. 
-    Perform all the operations relating to the production of radioisotope powders: encapsulation of ampoules, loading and unloading of capsules into and from the reactor, internal transport of irradiated capsules, cutting open of capsules in the hot cell, and conditioning of ampoules for shipment to European chemical processing centres. 
-    Operate and maintain the hot cells used to cut up irradiated equipment. 
-    Conduct periodic inspections and requalification of the pressure equipment used by the group (handling column valves, reactor valves, etc.). 
-    Manage maintenance sites from their preparatory phase through to completion of the work. 
-    Draft procedures, technical specifications and reports. 
-    Assist on an occasional basis with the operation of other equipment under the group's responsibility.
-    Maintain the power generators.

Desired profile
-    Level 5/6 qualification (BTEC HNC/HND, foundation degree or equivalent) in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, industrial maintenance or equivalent.
-    First professional experience in industrial maintenance. 
-    Good writing skills for the drafting of procedures, technical specifications and reports. 
-    "Hands-on" approach and a very high level of autonomy. 
-    Strong analytical skills, team spirit, versatility, and the ability to use your initiative. 
-    Practical experience of carrying out maintenance in nuclear installations would be an advantage. 
-    Fluency in French is essential; knowledge of English would be appreciated.

jobs.occupation: Nuclear Quality Assurance Engineer, INB - French basic nuclear installation
jobs.description:
Core mission:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.

The ILL's Quality, Risk Management and Nuclear Safety Unit (CQSR - Cellule Qualité Sûreté Risques) is a small, dynamic team of five people which reports directly to ILL Management. The core mission of the CQSR is to maintain and improve the ILL's Integrated Management System (IMS), which enables the Institute to comply with regulatory requirements for basic nuclear installations (INB - Installation nucléaire de base). This includes aspects relating to nuclear safety and quality management.

Your tasks:
As quality assurance engineer, you will play an active part in the development and maintenance of the IMS. Your main duties will be to:
- Manage the process for monitoring fulfilment of commitments (improvement actions)
- Manage the process for monitoring regulatory changes and compliance
- Propose solutions to help process managers maintain and improve their processes
- Support engineers and technicians with the documentation requirements associated with technical projects to upgrade the facility
- Participate in IMS process reviews
- Help to lead training sessions on the IMS
- Prepare and conduct internal and external quality audits (including field work) on IMS processes

Once you have received training:
- Take on the role of contact person for corruption prevention and fraud control officer (information gathering, awareness-raising, whistleblowing contact person)
- Perform event analyses from an HOF perspective
- Assist with the preparation of the periodic information campaign on industrial hazards

Your profile:
- Master's degree (or equivalent) in quality assurance or Master's degree in general engineering with proven experience in quality assurance.
- Solid professional experience is required.
- Experience in the nuclear sector is required.
- Proficiency in the use of MS Office applications (PowerPoint, Excel, etc.).

jobs.occupation: Technicien / Technicienne de maintenance en matériels informatiqu (H/F)
jobs.description:
Role Requirements & Responsibilities :

Field Execution and Technical Delivery :
- Attend client sites on time with all required equipment, PPE, documentation, and job readiness.
- Lead complex fibre and copper cabling installations across multi-rack, multi-room, or multi-phase deployments.
- Execute structured cabling tasks including routing, termination, dressing, patching, and cross-connects in live data centre environments.
- Validate job readiness before execution including materials, access approvals, drawings, risk assessments, and site conditions.
- Provide technical input into daily task sequencing and execution planning in coordination with Supervisors.
- Resolve non-standard field issues and implement corrective actions in line with customer standards.
- Ensure all installations follow approved methodologies, design documentation, and safety requirements..

Quality, Testing, and Documentation:
- Validate cable routing, dressing, labeling, and patching accuracy during and after execution.
- Support preparation, execution, and review of fibre and copper testing activities.
- Review test outputs and highlight deviations or quality risks to Supervisors.
- Maintain accurate cable schedules, as-built documentation, and task reporting.
- Identify quality gaps and initiate corrective actions in coordination with Supervisors and Project Leads.

Team Support and Coordination :
- Provide technical guidance and support to field teams during complex tasks.
- Act as technical escalation point for on-site cabling issues.
- Communicate progress, risks, and constraints clearly to Supervisors and Project Leads.
- Represent professionally in all customer-facing site interactions.

Safety and Compliance :
- Ensure compliance with all customer health, safety, and security procedures.
- Identify and escalate safety risks or non-compliant practices immediately.
- Support safety briefings and on-site adherence to operational rules..

 The role requires flexibility and adaptability to changing situations and customer requirements, so the candidate must be comfortable working under pressure and on strict timelines. The candidate must be adaptable while performing tasks, ready to change priorities and maintain professional communications with clients, colleagues and vendors.

The successful candidate will be required to possess and demonstrate the following:
- Strong organisational and problem-solving skills with high levels of attention to detail.
- Prior experience with the installation of structured cabling including fibre and copper.
- Strong understanding of structured cabling standards, pathways, and installation methodologies.
- Experience working in live data centre environments.
- Valid class B driving licence with a good driving record where travel is required.
- Basic experience with hand and power tools.
- Experience with Microsoft Word, Excel, Teams, and Email.
- Language proficiency at minimum B1 level in English.
- Proficiency in another European language would be advantageous..
The following qualifications, skills and experience would be an advantage.
- Minimum 3 to 4 years of hands-on experience in data centre cabling operations.
- Strong troubleshooting capability across fibre, copper, containment, and rack environments.
- Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, patching matrices, and test documentation.
- Demonstrated ability to lead field execution technically without formal line management.
- Experience mentoring junior technicians.
- Ability to travel for work across customer sites.

Join a team that keeps the world's digital infrastructure running. Every project makes a difference !
